stories.title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
stories.body: The PM's Likud party has alleged foreign interference and said Arab-led parties "stole" the election after his coalition lost its majority.

stories.title: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
stories.body: The leaked tapes appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move at normal speed, even though another up ahead had stalled.

stories.title: 'The city is alive': A brief peace in Kherson, but residents fear what comes next
stories.body: A temporary ceasefire has brought rare quiet to Kherson, offering its residents a glimpse of normal life before fighting resumes.

stories.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
stories.body: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
stories.body: The defeated presidential candidate says he will lead the opposition from the US.

stories.title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
stories.body: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.

stories.title: EU chief lays out vision for new Canada partnership at Montreal summit
stories.body: Ursula von der Leyen continued to use the term "associate member" for Canada despite some opposition of the bloc's members, including Germany.

stories.title: Rock collapse kills two in Turkey's Cappadocia, local media reports
stories.body: One of the region's famous rock formations, known as "fairy chimneys", reportedly collapsed outside an open-air museum.

stories.title: Record number of purges as Xi emphasises 'party discipline' at China political gathering
stories.body: Xi's anti-corruption campaign has become "an effort to consolidate and maintain authority", observers say.

stories.title: Details of thousands of US immigration agents leaked in major hack
stories.body: A group called the Department of Peace released information on more than 41,000 DHS staff.

stories.title: Alaska governor orders probe into Democratic campaign's alleged links to same-name candidate
stories.body: The Republican governor was responding to allegations in the New York Times that Democrats recruited a spoiler candidate, Dan Sullivan.

stories.title: Death of US actress Hayden Panettiere ruled accidental, ending local police probe
stories.body: The Heroes and Nashville star died in August from the toxic effects of fentanyl, Xanax and several other drugs.

stories.title: US sanctions Rwanda's defence ministry over DR Congo conflict
stories.body: Congo accuses Rwanda of backing M23 rebels and plundering minerals in its conflict hit East

stories.title: El Salvador sends 2,000 troops to Haiti to rescue four missing soldiers
stories.body: The troops are trying to recover four military personnel who went missing in an ambush on the outskirts of the Haitian capital Port-au-Prince.

stories.title: Ethiopia acquires Russian fighter jets and air defence systems amid war in Tigray
stories.body: The acquisition of the warplanes comes amid ongoing fighting in northern Tigray region that started last month.

stories.title: Audacious Indian jailbreak saga ends with 17 prisoners recaptured
stories.body: The jailbreak began with a fake seizure and ended 36 hours later with all the inmates back behind bars.

stories.title: 'Like cutting up a Picasso': AI microdrama edit of Neighbours worries actors and crew
stories.body: A micro-drama will use AI-assisted technology to edit old episodes of the Australian TV soap to focus on Margot Robbie's character.

stories.title: Elon Musk is a 'real genius', Putin says after satellite talks with SpaceX boss
stories.body: The Russian President praised Musk and said they are in "close" contact.

stories.title: Girl seriously injured in wolf attack at German wildlife park
stories.body: The eight-year-old was in an enclosure with other children and a staff member when she was attacked.

stories.title: Hello Kitty maker cuts ties with Japanese spy drama after China backlash
stories.body: Sanrio has apologised after its merchandise line with Japanese TV series Vivant drew criticism.
